The series has strong seasonality and moderate ranking stability; a trimmed mean might reduce influence of outlier models while still using many models.

focus on best low-error, diverse models
Test a different combination type – dba on the full pool to see if iterative optimization improves over weighted.
Test a weighted combo using the best_per_horizon handle (w5) on the full pool to exploit horizon‑specific strengths hinted by the moderate ranking stability and strong seasonality.
test per‑horizon top‑k mean weighting (w6) on the full pool to see if horizon‑specific averaging improves over global weighting.
The series shows strong seasonality and moderate ranking stability; a per‑horizon top‑k mean on a smaller, diverse pool may capture horizon‑specific strengths.
The best weighted pool4 used all 7 models; a different combination type (dba) on the same pool may exploit iterative optimization and could improve on the current leader.
Use weighted combination on the stable pool4 with inverse_error weights to exploit moderate ranking stability and strong seasonality.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w7' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.6229. Series context: trend strength 0.6332 and seasonal strength 0.8489; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.306); 8 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 4.344.
